name: runtime-control-handoff-built-node25
outputTail:
Compiled Runtime starts with its private credential.
Application backups refuse roots that overlap node execution control.
Gateway SIGKILL leaves the independently owned Runtime available.
A replacement Gateway authenticates the exact runtime generation.
A different credential cannot stop the active generation.
Confirmed stop joins the owned process range and retained runtime output.
A stopped credential generation cannot allocate again.
A fresh credential survives a repeated stop from the older handle.
Cancellation after preparation prevents independent runtime allocation.
